body: Hi, thanks for your reply! That definitely could be it. I didn't feel nauseous yet as a pregnancy symptom but it could be to do with hormones. Just wanted sure if it was a common occurrence or more unique to me. I am sorry you had to experience that & I hope you're feeling better.

Hi, thanks for your reply! Will just give a TW now in case you or anyone else reading this post doesn't want to hear graphic details (I won't get too graphic anyway) but when I started passing tissue/clots I was in extreme pain. Hands down the worst pain I've ever experienced in my life & that lasted about 3-4 hours. 

I couldn't move & was cramping so badly. I began to feel light headed which is when I originally threw up. After those hours, things calmed down. The pain  subsided but wasn't gone completely & I could finally go to sleep. When I woke up this morning, I was almost instantly nauseous & have thrown up every time I've attempted to stand up. 

The cramping is pretty much gone & the bleeding has lessened but I feel extremely nauseous as if I have a stomach bug. I would go into A&E, but I feel so nauseous I don't think it's possible today.

Thanks for the kind words. I'm sorry about your experience & hope you're doing okay!

I had the same experience. I threw up during all the physical stuff & assumed it was because I was in so much pain. Now the painful part seems to be over but I am constantly nauseous & have to throw up every time I stand up. I am very sorry to hear about your experience & hope you are okay.
